title: Remove code-restating comment
why: A comment that repeats the adjacent statement adds maintenance cost without explaining intent.
suggestion: Remove the comment or explain the constraint, tradeoff, or reason instead.
limitations: Only narrow return, assignment, increment, and invocation restatements are reported.

Documentation comments, test sources, Rust raw and multiline string contents, and JavaScript/TypeScript template text are excluded. Template interpolation is not resolved as a separate executable scope.
